# Try Omarchy v0.6.2

Download **TryOmarchy.exe** below, or let your installed launcher update itself. Your guest disk, files and settings carry over.

- **Security fix for the quick-start account.** If you forwarded a port to Omarchy's SSH (guest port 22), and especially if you made it a LAN forward, anyone who could reach that port could log in as `omarchy` / `omarchy` and use its passwordless sudo. SSH now accepts only keys for the quick-start account, and Try Omarchy authorizes your key when you set up the forward. Existing quick-start installs get this on their first boot after updating. Accounts you created yourself keep password login.
- **Your own account is the default for new installs.** The first-launch screen now preselects "Choose my username and password". The quick start is still one click away. Installs you already set up keep the choice you made.
- The quick-start welcome notice now suggests running `passwd` to set your own password.
- Setup now checks for enough free space to unpack Omarchy before downloading it, instead of running out partway through.

See the [compatibility guide](https://github.com/omacom/try-omarchy-windows/blob/master/docs/COMPATIBILITY.md) for hardware requirements and known limits.
